role: reviewed intentional packed export-name extras vs Material 16.2.14 legacy barrels

extras.name: MatCommonModule
extras.reason: Owned MatCommonModule is re-exported from each primary family so historical NgModule imports keep resolving without @angular/material/core private paths.

extras.name: _MatLegacyAutocompleteBase
extras.reason: Owned MDC-era base retained for extension and DI; peer removed the historical base export.

extras.name: _MatLegacyAutocompleteOriginBase
extras.reason: Owned origin base retained for extension; peer no longer exports the historical base.

extras.name: _MatLegacyAutocompleteTriggerBase
extras.reason: Owned trigger base retained for extension and scroll-strategy factories.

extras.name: _MatLegacyCheckboxBase
extras.reason: Owned checkbox base with local default-options factory.

extras.name: _MatOptgroupBase
extras.reason: Owned option-group base exported from legacy-core for cross-family consumers.

extras.name: _MatOptionBase
extras.reason: Owned option base exported from legacy-core for autocomplete/select consumers.

extras.name: _MatLegacyMenuBase
extras.reason: Owned menu base retained after peer removed legacy menu bases.

extras.name: _MatLegacyMenuContentBase
extras.reason: Owned menu content base retained for lazy content.

extras.name: _MatLegacyMenuTriggerBase
extras.reason: Owned menu trigger base with scroll-strategy factory provider.

extras.name: _MatLegacyRadioButtonBase
extras.reason: Owned radio button base retained for extension.

extras.name: _MatLegacyRadioGroupBase
extras.reason: Owned radio group base retained for extension.

extras.name: _MatLegacyTabLabelWrapperBase
extras.reason: Owned tab label-wrapper base retained for ink-bar alignment.

extras.name: _LegacyTooltipComponentBase
extras.reason: Owned tooltip component base retained after peer removed historical bases.

extras.name: _MatLegacyTooltipBase
extras.reason: Owned tooltip directive base with deferred overlay helpers.

extras.name: MatLegacyTabGroupBaseHeader
extras.reason: Owned tab-group header type alias exported for consumers typing custom headers.

extras.name: MatLegacyListHarnessBase
extras.reason: Explicit testing harness base export so packed .d.ts consumers can extend list harnesses the way 16.2.14 rolled declarations allowed.

extras.name: ListSection
extras.reason: Harness grouping type exported beside MatLegacyListHarnessBase for typed getItemsGroupedBySubheader results.

extras.name: _MatChipListHarnessBase
extras.reason: Explicit harness base export matching historical public_api_guard surface for chip list/listbox harnesses.

extras.name: LEGACY_ANIMATIONS_TEST_OVERRIDE
extras.reason: F04 engine-free motion test override; not present on Material 16.2.14.

extras.name: LEGACY_ZERO_ANIMATION_PARAMS
extras.reason: Zero-duration params helper for engine-free motion tests.

extras.name: LegacyAnimationsState
extras.reason: Owned animations-state type for MATERIAL_ANIMATIONS consumers.

extras.name: MATERIAL_ANIMATIONS
extras.reason: Public token replacing Angular Animations recipes removed under F04.

extras.name: getLegacyAnimationsState
extras.reason: Helper to read MATERIAL_ANIMATIONS state.

extras.name: legacyAnimationTriggerState
extras.reason: Maps disabled/enabled motion into historical trigger state strings.

extras.name: legacyAnimationsDisabled
extras.reason: Predicate used by components to skip CSS/Web Animations.

extras.name: legacyGetEventTarget
extras.reason: Shadow-DOM-safe event target helper used by motion and focus code.

extras.name: legacyGetShadowRoot
extras.reason: Shadow-root helper used by progress-spinner and motion code.

extras.name: legacyHostMotionEvent
extras.reason: Main-line motion helper for host animation end events; absent on 21.x by design.

extras.name: legacyIsNumberValue
extras.reason: Shared numeric coercion helper used by owned bases.

extras.name: legacyNextMotionCompletion
extras.reason: Main-line motion completion helper; absent on 21.x by design.

extras.name: legacySupportsShadowDom
extras.reason: Feature detect used by shadow-aware helpers.

extras.name: zeroAnimationParams
extras.reason: Alias of LEGACY_ZERO_ANIMATION_PARAMS for historical import sites.

extras.name: defaultParams
extras.reason: CSS duration defaults retained on the primary dialog entry after F04 removed the animations secondary; 16.2.14 exposed these only via that secondary.

extras.name: _defaultParams
extras.reason: Canonical dialog duration params object paired with defaultParams.

extras.name: LEGACY_MENU_PANEL_TOP_PADDING
extras.reason: Owned menu panel padding constant used by the trigger positioning path.

extras.name: MAT_LEGACY_MENU_SCROLL_STRATEGY_FACTORY
extras.reason: Owned menu scroll-strategy factory; historical name kept on the primary entry.

extras.name: MAT_LEGACY_MENU_SCROLL_STRATEGY_FACTORY_PROVIDER
extras.reason: Owned menu scroll-strategy factory provider used by MatLegacyMenuModule.

extras.name: MAT_LEGACY_TAB_LABEL
extras.reason: Re-export of MAT_TAB_LABEL under the legacy name for consumers that imported the token from the legacy tabs entry; 16.2.14 public-api omitted this alias while shipping the token via other paths.

extras.name: getListItemPredicate
extras.reason: Explicit export of the harness predicate helper so packed consumers can build filters the way 16.2.14 rolled declarations exposed it.

extras.name: MatLegacyListItemHarnessBase
extras.reason: Explicit list item harness base export for extending action/nav/selection item harnesses.

extras.name: MatLegacySubheaderHarness
extras.reason: Explicit subheader harness export used with MatLegacyListHarnessBase grouping APIs.

signature_deltas.reason: Angular ɵcmp/ɵdir/ɵfac/ɵprov and decorator metadata shapes follow the installed compiler, not Material 16.2.14 text.

limitations: Allowlist covers export names only. G02 still requires full signature/overload/identity closure.
Signature comparison in api-completeness.mjs is structural member-name evidence, not a full declaration diff.
